roomList.short: La salle de l'évêque · The bishop's hall

cathedrale.name: La salle de l'évêque · The bishop's hall
cathedrale.alt: The bishop's hall inside the honey-stone gothic cathedral, painted in ink and gouache: the tall open door on the left looks out on the sunny cathedral square and its twin spires; beside it a credence table holds a miter, a crosier and other treasures; a cheerful bishop proudly holds up a giant carrot on the red carpet; on the right a group portrait of the clergy with a blue jay on its frame, a model dome in a wooden vat beside a tin can, three stools in a semicircle with open books, a pop-up pope over a book on the lectern, a council table with a sealed scroll, and a cardinal with a red cardinal bird, a young priest with a tray of teacups, an old parish priest watering a geranium and a young curate with a basket of bread and apples. A small portrait of a smiling monsignor in a black cassock with a purple sash hangs between the gothic window and the clergy portrait.

credence.name: La crédence · The credence table
credence.alt: Close-up of the credence table: a white miter with a tape measure, a golden crosier lying across the cloth, a little painting of candles in a neat row on the open door, a rolled letter riding a tiny bicycle, a sealed letter on a little post with a leek, a crossed-keys coat of arms on the wall, a wedge of cheese holding down a map, a model chapel with a cone roof and a white puff, a figurine of a seminarian balancing books on his wrist and a figurine of the pope standing on a stone bridge; at the right edge the bishop's hand holds a giant carrot.
